sn47.45:1.1: kusalarāsīti bhikkhave vadamāno cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn47.45:1.2: kevalo hāyaṃ bhikkhave kusalarāsi yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
sn47.45:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
sn47.45:2.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.45:2.6: kusalarāsīti bhikkhave vadamāno ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn47.45:2.7: kevalo hāyaṃ bhikkhave kusalarāsi yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānāti.
